title: Knowledge-Grounded Engineering Design Agent
summary: Investigating RAG and Knowledge Graph retrieval to help LLM agents use drone engineering data, requirements, and design evidence more accurately.
overview: This is an exploratory research direction, not a completed validated engineering design system. It focuses on retrieving and organizing design-domain information from technical documents so an LLM agent can support evidence-based decisions.

sections.heading: Research Questions
sections.body: How should technical documents, tables, and relations be organized so that an agent can retrieve the right design evidence? How do vector retrieval and graph-based retrieval differ in accuracy and latency?

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: Compare chunking, embeddings, table processing, entity/relation extraction, community detection, and retrieval strategies under repeatable benchmark questions.

sections.heading: Current Status
sections.body: Prototype research and benchmarking are ongoing. Performance results and verified figures can be added once validated.

title: LLM-Assisted CAE Decision Subprocessor
summary: A proof-of-concept framework linking image-based modeling commands, simulation databases, and LLM reasoning for structural analysis workflows.
overview: Developed and integrated a workflow that maps image/modeling commands to Abaqus scripts and modifies selected analysis parameters with explicit structural safeguards.

sections.heading: Implementation
sections.body: Integrated an LLM editing engine, image-to-script mapping, JSON guardrails, AST-based script changes, SI-unit normalization, and noGUI analysis linkage.

sections.heading: Technical Emphasis
sections.body: Focused on robust parameter changes, analysis reuse, and reliable engineering command interpretation rather than unrestricted code generation.

sections.heading: Research Output
sections.body: Related first-author journal article accepted by Journal of Mechanical Science and Technology in 2026.

title: Web-Based Dynamics Modeling & Simulation
summary: Image recognition, Lagrangian dynamics, numerical integration, and web visualization connected in one simulation platform.
overview: Created an end-to-end workflow from image recognition and Lagrangian DAE modeling to Runge–Kutta simulation and real-time web visualization.

sections.heading: Engineering Workflow
sections.body: Built a 50-sample dataset and implemented a robust Python–GNU Octave communication protocol with length-prefix framing and polling.

sections.heading: Validation
sections.body: Compared dynamic behavior with SolidWorks Motion under matched model conditions.

sections.heading: Recognition
sections.body: Associated poster presentation received an Excellence in Presentation Award at the 2025 KSEE Annual Conference.

title: 20-Inch Bicycle Wheel Design Optimization
summary: Comparative finite element analysis of wheel geometry alternatives under mechanical loads and practical manufacturing constraints.
overview: Compared a reference wheel with alternative geometries that varied spoke count, spoke arrangement, and rib thickness.

sections.heading: Method
sections.body: Applied matched ground-contact, hub, axial load, and tire pressure conditions while controlling meshing and convergence criteria.

sections.heading: Design Criteria
sections.body: Evaluated von Mises stress, factor of safety, mass, manufacturability, and cost trade-offs.
